text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with King
Halo...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Look! Those cute plushies look as
though they're
sending me their praises!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало points toward a claw machine
filled
with Umamusume plushies.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, wouldn't it be stellar to add them
to my
ever-growing support group, the
Halo Army?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It's decided! I'm granting you the right to
win and
collect those plushies for me!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Of course, you! Isn't that part of your job
as my
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Now, go be a good first-rate trainer and
show off
those claw machine skills!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll be with you the entire
time! Give
it your all!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
